Privacy

Privacy policy

Short version: the game doesn't collect anything about you.

The iPhone app

No accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. Player names, your own words and your settings are saved only on your phone, and deleting the app deletes them. The app only goes online for Play together (below). Links to this website open in Safari.

Play together (party mode)

When you host or join a party, your phone connects to the other phones in it. To find each other, the phones use the free PeerJS server, which sees your IP address and the party code. If the phones can't connect directly, the game goes through a PeerJS relay, encrypted. The name you pick, the clues you type and the host's own words go only to the phones in your party. Nothing is saved after the party ends.

Share your party code only with people you know. The host can remove anyone and lock the party. To report a player or something someone typed, use the feedback form.

This website

The phone game on this site saves your settings and names only in your browser. The site loads its font from Google Fonts, and it's hosted on GitHub Pages; both can see your IP address, like any website you visit. We don't use cookies, ads or analytics.

Feedback

If you send feedback, the name, email and message you type are emailed to us through Web3Forms so we can read them and, if you ask, reply. They aren't shared, sold or added to any list.

Kids

The game is for ages 10 and up and doesn't knowingly collect anything from anyone.

Questions

Use the feedback form. Last updated November 16, 2026.
